title: Hamster wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hamster body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='27' ry='23' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#f7dcae'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='8' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#f2a6a6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='8' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#f2a6a6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- face light patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f7dcae'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='3.2' fill='#3a2b5c'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='3.2' fill='#3a2b5c'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='2.2' ry='1.6' fill='#d76b8a'/>
  <path d='M50 57 q-2.5 3 -5 0.5' stroke='#a8632f' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 57 q2.5 3 5 0.5' stroke='#a8632f' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M36 56 l-12 -2' stroke='#c99354' stroke-width='1.1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 60 l-12 2' stroke='#c99354' stroke-width='1.1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 56 l12 -2' stroke='#c99354' stroke-width='1.1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 60 l12 2' stroke='#c99354' stroke-width='1.1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#f2c98c'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#f2c98c'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M50 8 L38 32 L62 32 Z' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <path d='M44 26 L56 26 L54.5 20 L45.5 20 Z' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <path d='M46.5 20 L53.5 20 L52.5 14 L47.5 14 Z' fill='#f06292'/>
  <!-- hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='24' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#f06292'/>
</svg>
